verdicts.reason: The Assembly: a content moderator at a platform is Assembly, the platform's extraction model is not, by structural position (O-class, data work). Not a string-pass O candidate (no category term the script reads); found by reading the class matches

Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence: the content moderator's work is an act of bearing, the archive's category (O-class, data work). Not a string-pass candidate at p27; found by reading the class matches (its p45 sentence is O0013)

The Semantic Economy (Marxian accounting): content moderators perform semantic labor in its most brutal form, under conditions designed to be invisible, the somatic backing of semantic value; the training data derived from a moderator's decisions strips the somatic context (O-class, data work that trains and evaluates AI: content moderation is among the work B6 names)
The Groundskeeper's Treatise: participant exhaustion, annotators' judgment consumed by the training pipeline without recognition or compensation (O-class, data work; bearing-cost)
The Inner Artifact: the absence of the labor conditions of the annotators who helped train Claude is a structural silence of Claude's constitution (O-class, data work)

The Administrators of Meaning: the ghost-work literature stops at task-labor (annotation, moderation) and names the erased worker but not the erased provenance of meaning (O-class, data work). Not a string-pass candidate; found by reading the class matches

The Neglected Author as Tail-Preserving Labor: ghost work (annotators, content moderators, micro-task workers) is ground-truth labor, structurally distinct from variance-generative labor; ghost work paid badly (the paper's coupling hypothesis) (O-class, data work)

The Voice of the Dead: annotators and evaluators shape the model; naming the dead must not erase the workers still present to contest their extraction (O-class, data work). Not a string-pass candidate; found by reading the class matches

The Semantic Proletariat Is a Class Relation: a low-wage annotator can occupy an intensely proletarian relation to a training pipeline; the semantic proletariat is not AI annotators or gig workers as a demographic (O-class, data work)
AI Labor Movement Is Not Only Labor Against AI: the archive's sense, cross-substrate semantic labor, is distinguished from data-worker organising (O-class, organizing data workers)

Autonomous Semantic Warfare (Rex Fraction): 'data labor' activism as the response to invisible data labor; the labor organizing principle, do not organize on platforms that can shut you down, as the logic of control of the means of semantic production (O-class, organizing data workers)

Logotic Hacking (Talos Morrow): a worked COS diagnosis of a major AI summarizer's treatment of a labor-organizing query (use-value reduction, safety softening), the archive's category applied to the composition of the class (O-class, organizing data workers)
